summary: No feasible option: both options require reading the payments ledger, for which the job has no authorized credential (FAILED_NO_FEASIBLE_OPTION).

findings.problem: OPT-A needs read access to the ledger service API; factory policy lists no credential for it (policy grants: app DB read/write only).
findings.expected_fix: Operator grants a scoped ledger read credential, or the request is revised to exclude ledger operations.

findings.problem: OPT-B replicates ledger rows nightly, which needs the same credential and adds a new trust boundary not allowed by constraints.
findings.expected_fix: Same as F-1; no option can satisfy REQ-1 without ledger access.

checked_criteria: Hard constraints and policy credentials checked for OPT-A and OPT-B

infeasible_reasons: Requires ledger API credential not granted by policy
